Cal. 3235 & 300m Water Resistance

The unidirectional black ceramic bezel and clean dial create a perfectly balanced face. The 60-minute graduation with platinum PVD numerals is the only distraction from the watch's meditative simplicity.

Powering the no-date Submariner is Cal. 3230 — without the date module, allowing for a thinner profile. 70-hour power reserve, COSC-certified, and 300m water resistant.

Fluted Gold Bezel – The Datejust Signature

The Datejust 41 126333 is distinguished by its iconic 18 ct yellow gold fluted bezel — one of Rolex's most recognizable design signatures since 1945. Set in Yellow Rolesor (Oystersteel and 18 ct yellow gold), the bold 41mm case combines the durability of steel with the warmth and prestige of gold, creating a watch that is both powerful and elegant.

Bright Black Dial with Cyclops Lens Date Window

The glossy bright black dial features a sunray finish and luminescent applied hour markers with baton indices, delivering a bold yet refined aesthetic. The date window at 3 o'clock, magnified by the iconic Cyclops lens, ensures instant legibility. The Chromalight display emits a long-lasting blue glow for perfect readability in the dark.

The Jubilee Bracelet – Born with the Datejust

Created in 1945 alongside the original Datejust, the five-piece Jubilee bracelet in Oystersteel and 18 ct yellow gold remains the definitive expression of wrist elegance. The Oysterlock safety clasp with Easylink extension ensures a precise and secure fit, allowing for approximately 5 mm of adjustment.

Calibre 3235 – Precision Redefined

At the heart of the Datejust 41 is the Rolex Calibre 3235, a self-winding mechanical movement manufactured entirely in-house. Certified as a Superlative Chronometer with precision of +/-2 seconds per day, the Calibre 3235 offers approximately 70 hours of power reserve and features a Parachrom hairspring and Paraflex shock absorbers for exceptional robustness.
